evidence: app/package.json:6-9 — no test script, no test runner dependency anywhere in the app
app/src/lib/data.js:76-90 — species dedupe/alternate-form exclusion, the most refactored-prone logic, has no tests
app/src/pages/index.astro:36-58 — filtering, generation membership and 48-per-page pagination are only covered by the acceptance suite
coverage_of_risk.rationale: The app contains zero tests of its own; none of its data transformation, filtering, pagination, URL-state or error-handling logic is protected by anything the team will own.

evidence: app/ — no test files exist (facts: tests.files 0, runner [])
behaviour_not_implementation.rationale: No tests, so nothing to assess; the criterion cannot be satisfied.

evidence: app/src/lib/format.js:10 — humanize() (mr-mime → Mr Mime) untested; a broken capitalization rule would pass unnoticed
app/public/js/home.js:29-34 — seq race guard and pushState URL building unguarded by any test
app/src/lib/api.js:36-50 — mapAll error propagation (partial results on one rejection) untested
regression_power.rationale: With no tests, breaking any covered behaviour — breaking everything from humanize to pagination to sort ordering — fails nothing owned by the app.

evidence: app/ — zero test files, so zero maintenance cost and zero noise
signal_to_noise.rationale: Rubric assigns 3 when there are no tests: no noise, but no signal either.

findings.issue: Pure, easily unit-testable helpers (humanize, dexNumber, latestEnglishFlavor, idFromUrl, orDash) ship with no tests; every rendered name and dex number depends on them
findings.suggestion: Add Vitest with getViteConfig() (per current Astro testing guide) and cover each helper's edge cases (empty words, null entries, non-numeric IDs) — an afternoon of work

findings.issue: pokemonRefsToSpecies (species dedupe, id<=10000 exclusion, dex-order sort) is unguarded; a refactor here silently corrupts every card list on move/ability/type pages
findings.suggestion: Unit test with fixture refs containing duplicate species and an alternate form (id 10001) and assert exclusion, dedupe and ordering

findings.issue: Filtering (search substring, type slot membership, generation membership) and pagination (48/page, silent clamp of out-of-range page to last page) have no regression coverage once the acceptance suite is gone
findings.suggestion: Extract the filter/paginate logic into a pure function and unit test it (empty filters, no matches, page beyond total, page=0/NaN)

findings.issue: Client-side URL-state logic — debounce, pushState, seq race guard, DOMParser innerHTML swap, popstate reload — is untested; race and back-button bugs will surface only as intermittent user reports
findings.suggestion: Cover with Playwright component/e2e tests: type quickly, click back, assert URL and rendered results match; or extract a build-url function and unit test it

findings.issue: Table sorting (textContent comparison, missing-sorts-last, aria-sort flip) is untested and fragile — e.g. Number() on unexpected cell text yields NaN comparisons that silently misorder
findings.suggestion: E2E test clicking each sortable header on /pokemon/pikachu?game=... and asserting row order and aria-sort state

findings.issue: mapAll has no error strategy: one rejected fetch propagates while other workers keep running (partial side effects), and cached promises add another concurrency wrinkle at api.js:19-34
findings.suggestion: Unit test mapAll directly (order preservation, concurrency bound, rejection behavior) and decide on a fail-fast or collect-errors policy

findings.issue: Only status-404 is handled; any other API error (network, 500) throws and renders an unstyled server error page — untested error path repeated in moves/abilities/types pages
findings.suggestion: Add a test for a transient API failure (or a non-404 resource) and return a graceful error page instead of an unhandled throw

findings.issue: Species dedupe keeps the first entry's is_hidden flag; a species listed twice with differing flags would show the wrong 'Hidden ability' label, and nothing tests it
findings.suggestion: Unit test the dedupe with a fixture where a species appears as both normal and hidden

findings.issue: An invalid type/generation filter value silently yields 'No Pokémon found' with no reset or feedback — an untested edge in URL handling
findings.suggestion: Either reset unknown filters to defaults or keep as-is deliberately, but lock the choice in a test

summary: The app wrote no tests at all: no runner, no test script, no test files. That's a real loss because the riskiest logic — species dedupe and form exclusion (data.js), URL-state race handling (home.js), table sorting, filtering and pagination — is exactly the code a future refactor would break silently once the acceptance suite is no longer the only guard. Worse, much of it is already factored into pure functions in lib/format.js and lib/data.js that Vitest (Astro's current recommendation) could cover in a few hours.

untested.area: Client URL-state and race handling: debounce, pushState, superseded-fetch guard, DOMParser swap, popstate reload (app/public/js/home.js:20-44)
